description: Figure 5 (right-side plot) is intended to show the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values across network layers under a threshold setting of 1e-3, with multiple line series corresponding to different gating-related measurements. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from 0 to a little over 20 (with labeled ticks at regular intervals of about 5 layers). The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with evenly spaced tick labels (about 0.2 increments). Three lines are shown: a blue dashed line (with no visible markers) that starts near about 0.15 at layer 0 and quickly drops to near 0.02 by around layer 2, then stays close to ~0.01–0.02 through the final layers; an orange dotted line that begins near 1.0 at layer 0 and declines steadily to roughly 0.25–0.35 by the mid-to-late layers, with noticeable upward spikes near the end (around layers ~20–22) reaching roughly 0.4–0.5 before ending; and a green dash-dot line that starts near 1.0 at layer 0 and decreases more smoothly toward low values, reaching around ~0.1 by the mid layers and approaching roughly ~0.03–0.06 by the last layer.
